user.title: Set up Sonoff ZHA
user.description: Click Submit to enable the Sonoff ZHA integration. It registers the bundled ZHA custom quirks for SONOFF Zigbee devices (currently the SWV-ZF2 dual-channel water valve). There is nothing to configure here. A Home Assistant restart may be required for the quirks to apply to already-joined devices, followed by a Reconfigure on the device.

abort.already_configured: Sonoff ZHA is already set up.

irrigation_by_liters.name: Liters (volume irrigation)
irrigation_by_liters.description: Volume: opens the chosen channel of the SONOFF SWV-ZF2 valve; the valve closes it by itself once the target liters have been delivered.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The SONOFF SWV-ZF2 valve to irrigate with.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: Which of the two valve channels to open.

liters.name: Liters
liters.description: Target volume to deliver, in liters.

fail_safe_minutes.name: Fail-safe timeout
fail_safe_minutes.description: Maximum time the channel may stay open, in minutes (0 disables the fail-safe). If not set, the valve keeps its current fail-safe setting.

irrigation_by_minutes.description: Time: opens the chosen channel of the SONOFF SWV-ZF2 valve; the valve closes it by itself when the set minutes are up.
